title: Implement namespace normalization for Fabric Data and Logging in setup pages and platform management
summary: Fabric namespace fields on the setup pages and API now convert entered values to lowercase on validation, and new setup records default to businesscentral and businesscentral_log. This avoids casing mismatches in Fabric landing zone folder paths. Existing stored values are not renamed.
key_points: Namespace values entered through the Fabric setup pages or API are lowercased on validation
New setup records use lowercase defaults businesscentral and businesscentral_log
Existing stored namespace values are not migrated, so exported tables, reports and models are not disrupted
Direct AL writes that bypass the page validation can still store uppercase values
Tests cover the lowercase defaults and the namespace normalization
quote: Using lowercase consistently avoids mismatches when data is accessed through both case-insensitive T-SQL and potentially case-sensitive Spark.
